canonical.wire: wire = JSON.stringify(frame) with no whitespace and with object key order exactly as listed in each vector; checker recomputes and must equal expect byte for byte
canonical.frame_key_order: v,t,id,ts then per-type payload keys in the order given by CBP-v1.json properties
canonical.ts_rule: frame ts is float64 Unix seconds; envelope ts string = new Date(ts*1000).toISOString() only (_BUILD-PLAN.md 3.1); vectors use timestamps exactly representable to ms
canonical.string_values: every segment data value is a string on the wire (onebot-11 message/array.md:23 @d4456ee70); numeric host params must be coerced by the framework-side bridge before the frame is sent

rules.error_code_provenance: v12 baseline verbatim upstream/onebot@d533f0fca specs/action-response.md:43-99 (d-onebot-spec 6.1); 6xxxx band verbatim c1-adapters-per-framework 5.4; 4xxxx/5xxxx unused
rules.message_format: message = mnemonic for the code; when a native host error is translated the message becomes mnemonic + ": " + native detail kept verbatim

render_table.provenance: cortico-world-onebot@2e91b7fb1 src/render.js:32-85 whitelist with [type] default (d-bridge-priorart 2.2); kernel segment.ts is the sole implementation point (C1-16)
render_table.at: qq==all then @全体成员 else @ + qq (name lookup not available from segment data alone)
render_table.unknown: literal bracket wrap of seg.type, so seg.type pdf renders [pdf]
render_table.button_to_v11_callback: literal prefix [Button unavailable] then space then label (same source, verbatim literal)

trigger_ladder.self_echo: debounce with deliver:false and contextDelivery archive-only

rules.self_echo_rule: world-side detection: msg.sender.id equals the account self id learned at bridge setup; then event <w>.message.self (d-bridge-priorart 7 rule 4; blueprint 3.2)
rules.platform_msg_id: String(raw.message_id) when raw.message_id present else null; raw kept verbatim always
rules.notice_envelope: text = notice.kind; meta = {conv if present, kind, raw}
rules.connection_envelope: text and meta.kind = "connection/" + data.state, state one of ready|closed (onebot precedent world.js:999-1034)
rules.degraded_envelope: text and meta.kind = "degraded/" + data.cause; meta = {kind, cause, detail}
rules.neko_payload_gate: local reject when translated payload bytes > 524288 - 227 = 524061 (r-neko 5 MESSAGE_PLANE_PAYLOAD_MAX_BYTES and _HOST_ENVELOPE_HEADROOM_BYTES; _BUILD-PLAN.md 2.4 ingress row)
